title: CapabilityToken
description: The one-time credential the kernel mints on a permitting decision (ALLOW/LIMIT). The executor MUST refuse to perform an effect without a valid, unexpired, matching token. This is the mechanism that makes mediation MANDATORY: a caller cannot execute by bypassing the kernel, because it cannot forge the kernel's signature.

token_id.description: Unique id; single-use. The executor records spent token_ids to prevent replay.

action_ref.description: Binds the token to a single action (matches the Decision.action_ref). A token for one action cannot authorize another.

issued_by.description: The minting authority — the decision-kernel-core. No other component may mint tokens.

expires_at.description: Expiry (RFC3339 UTC). A short TTL bounds the replay window.

signature.description: Signature (e.g. Ed25519 hex) over the token's canonical form, by a key held ONLY by the kernel. This is what a bypassing caller cannot forge.
